dedupe_keys.name: a harmonised global building material intensity database for uncertainty aware building stock analysis

description: A Harmonised Global Building Material Intensity Database for Uncertainty-Aware Building Stock Analysis is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Wanyu Pei, Yuqian Ang (Department of Building Environment, National University of Singapore). This release contains the harmonised global building material intensity (MI) database and companion probabilistic query-model artefacts described in the associated Scientific Data manuscript. It includes the integrated MI dataset, trained model artefacts, preprocessing pipeline, and source code for inference and reproducible reuse. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
